_comment: SODA components manifest. The installer reads this to decide what to fetch.
Versions are PINNED on purpose. SODA redistributes nothing -- every item
below is downloaded by the user from its own publisher -- but a floating
'latest' would mean every install got a different combination, and a
breaking change upstream would break new installs while existing ones
kept working. That is a bug report nobody can reproduce.
This file is hosted rather than shipped so a moved download URL is a
one-line edit here instead of a new release everyone has to install.
Moving a pin forward is a deliberate act after testing. Never automatic.

python.note: Embeddable build. Only fetched when no suitable Python is already installed.

packages._comment: Installed from PyPI. Versions verified working together on 2026-08-17.

optional_packages._comment: Only needed to draft with Claude. Gemini, OpenRouter and Ollama all speak plain HTTP and need nothing installed.

model.verified: 2026-08-17, checksum computed from a known-good local copy and the remote size confirmed to match

_comment: LGPL rather than GPL, and a dated autobuild tag rather than 'latest',
because 'latest' is a moving target and this file is supposed to pin.
SODA only uses loudnorm and an mp3 encoder, so most of this build is

Checked first: many people already have ffmpeg on PATH and can skip
ffmpeg.note: Size is approximate and sha256 is not yet computed; the fetcher should verify size and fall back to a clear error rather than assuming a truncated download is fine.

totals._comment: What a user with none of this already installed downloads once: the model, voices, ffmpeg, Python and the pinned pip packages.

licences._comment: SODA distributes none of the below. Each is fetched by the user from its own publisher and remains under its own terms. Shown in-app before anything is downloaded.
